metadata.title: MacroLens Indian Macroeconomic Seed Dataset
metadata.notes: Curated from official government and regulatory releases (MOSPI, RBI, MoF, S&P Global). Used as verified historical baseline for MacroLens V1.

indicators.name: Manufacturing PMI
indicators.description: Purchasing Managers' Index tracking factory orders, output, employment, and supplier deliveries. Reading above 50 signals expansion.
indicators.methodology_note: Standard leading indicator: Forward-looking metrics (new export orders, input buying) signal factory output 1–3 months in advance.

indicators.name: Services PMI
indicators.description: Purchasing Managers' Index tracking output and new business in India's services sector, which constitutes >50% of GVA.
indicators.methodology_note: Forward-looking for new commercial contracts, but because services are produced and consumed simultaneously, it also shares strong coincident characteristics.

indicators.name: Non-Food Bank Credit Growth
indicators.description: Year-on-year growth in scheduled commercial bank lending to industry, services, and retail borrowers. Foretells capex and consumption.
indicators.methodology_note: Mixed / Context-dependent: Credit availability enables investment, but empirical studies show headline bank credit often coincides with or lags turning points because loan disbursements trail corporate decisions and working capital rises late in the cycle.

indicators.name: 10Y G-Sec vs 91-Day T-Bill Spread
indicators.description: Yield difference between 10-year sovereign benchmark bond and 91-day Treasury Bill. Steepening signals future growth; inversion flags tight liquidity/slowdown.
indicators.methodology_note: Classic term-premium leading indicator. Note: In India, Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) mandates and central bank debt management operations partially moderate curve slope sensitivity relative to developed markets.

indicators.name: Gross GST Collections
indicators.description: Monthly gross Goods and Services Tax receipts across CGST, SGST, IGST, and Cess. Direct high-frequency gauge of formal trade activity.
indicators.methodology_note: Coincident: Reflects tax on value-added transactions in the immediate reference month, providing an accurate reading of formal economic activity.

indicators.name: Index of Industrial Production (IIP)
indicators.description: Volume of production in mining, manufacturing, and electricity sectors compared with the corresponding month of the prior year.
indicators.methodology_note: Standard coincident indicator of physical production volumes in the industrial economy.

indicators.name: Electricity Demand Growth
indicators.description: Year-on-year growth in national electricity generation and transmission. Proxies factory capacity utilization and commercial power load.
indicators.methodology_note: Real-time physical coincident indicator capturing aggregate baseload power utilization across commercial, industrial, and agricultural sectors.

indicators.name: Passenger Vehicle Dispatches
indicators.description: Domestic passenger car factory shipments to dealers. Serves as a barometer for middle-class discretionary consumer expenditure.
indicators.methodology_note: Mixed / Wholesale vs. Retail Caveat: SIAM data tracks OEM factory shipments to dealers, not end-consumer retail registrations (Vahan). OEM wholesale push can diverge from actual consumer off-take during dealer inventory build-ups.

indicators.name: Headline CPI Inflation
indicators.description: All-India Consumer Price Index (Combined) YoY inflation. Primary anchor for RBI monetary policy with a target of 4.0% +/- 2%.
indicators.methodology_note: Standard lagging indicator: Reflects the cumulative pass-through of past aggregate demand and supply shocks into final consumer prices.

indicators.name: WPI Inflation
indicators.description: Wholesale Price Index measuring producer-level price pressure in manufactured products, fuel & power, and primary commodities.
indicators.methodology_note: Methodological Nuance: Grouped with price indices, but changes in wholesale/producer prices typically lead retail CPI by 2–3 months as input costs transmit through supply chains into consumer goods.

indicators.name: RBI Policy Repo Rate
indicators.description: The benchmark interest rate at which the RBI lends short-term liquidity to commercial banks against government securities.
indicators.methodology_note: Standard lagging indicator: Monetary policy interest rate decisions react retrospectively to past quarterly GDP and trailing inflation prints.

indicators.name: Quarterly Real GDP Growth
indicators.description: Real Gross Domestic Product year-on-year growth at constant prices. Definitive but retrospective measure of total economic expansion.
indicators.methodology_note: Standard lagging indicator: Definitive national output metric published with a 60-day lag after the reference quarter closes.
